subject.title: fix(net-policy): preserve repeated secret query params

question: Should this PR decouple display redaction from git managed-repo cache identity before merge, or may duplicate-secret git specs intentionally get a new managed repo path?
rationale: The code fix improves display fidelity, but the same helper is currently part of a persisted install identity, so accepting the output change is an upgrade compatibility decision rather than a pure code-style choice.

options.title: Require cache-identity repair
options.body: Keep the display fix but require a stable or migration-backed git managed-repo key before merge.

options.title: Accept rare git path drift
options.body: Merge the display behavior and explicitly accept that duplicate-secret git specs may re-clone or update as fresh installs after upgrade.

recommendation.title: Require cache-identity repair
recommendation.body: Keep the display fix but require a stable or migration-backed git managed-repo key before merge.
